- **Due**: Week 3 (Friday, September 11)
- **Points**: Counts toward professionalism
- **Submit to**: Meeting with your client
- **Submission**: By Individual

## Instructions

Hold your first meeting with your client. Come prepared with questions, and work
through the [Contract and Timeline](04-contract-timeline.qmd) together during
the meeting.

There is no class this week so that you can schedule this meeting.
